entities.summary: Britiande is a town in Portugal. It is a commune (freguesia) of Lamego Municipality. The population in 2011 was 934, in an area of 4.80 km2. Britiande was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
